title: Live: from the M5, screenshot and click on the Studio through its tailnet link

before.done_when: info answers; a screenshot comes back; a click lands in a test-bench window opened for it; with the switch off, or paused, the same calls are refused

history.what: openURL opens only http(s) links, so the bench page is served locally on the Studio instead of a data: URL (found building S-16)

before.done_when: from the M5 (a tailnet device, so tailscale serve adds the login header): info answers; a screenshot comes back; after asking Jordan, the API's open-link action opens a data: URL test-bench page that logs clicks on the Studio, and a click at a point from the screenshot shows up in its log; with the switch Off, then with Pause on, the same curl for actions answers 403

done_when: from the M5 (a tailnet device, so tailscale serve adds the login header): info answers; a screenshot comes back; after asking Jordan, the API's open-link action opens a test-bench page served by a throwaway local http server on the Studio (openURL opens only http(s) links), which logs clicks, and a click at a point from the screenshot shows up in its log; with the switch Off, then with Pause on, the same curl for actions answers 403
